column1: # Corrections to what SCOWL and Google Books say, one word per line, spelled as
# it should be offered: `word`, or `word<TAB>rank` to place it no lower than the
# word at that rank in the books-only order. Hand-kept, MIT like the rest of
# Funput. Every floor below is a judgement call; keep the reason next to it.
# Tokenization: Google Books splits it into `can not`, so books rank it ~43,700.
# After the corpus, or used online far more than in print (books rank in brackets).
